# pyrung.com

> Ladder logic as text. This account site is the small index for the pyrung.com project family; detailed documentation lives on each project site.

- [Overview](https://pyrung.com/overview/): How the projects fit together, the CLICK workflow, and important boundaries.
- [Blog](https://pyrung.com/blog/): Ladder design, practical CLICK work, and engineering notes.
- [ClickNick](https://pyrung.com/clicknick/): The CLICK-facing workbench for autocomplete, checks, offline testing, workspaces, and reviewed ladder changes.
- [pyrung](https://pyrung.com/pyrung/): Python ladder source, execution, testing, analysis, verification, and hardware targets.
- [laddercodec](https://pyrung.com/laddercodec/): CLICK ladder clipboard and program format codec.
- [pyclickplc](https://pyrung.com/pyclickplc/): CLICK-compatible Modbus TCP and address, nickname, and Data View tooling.
